versions.content: The AUTOSAR UdpNm algorithm shall support up to 250 nodes per NM-Cluster by default. Note: The AUTOSAR UdpNm algorithm can support an arbitrary number of nodes per NM-cluster (even more than default 250 nodes per cluster, if necessary) – it is only a matter of configuration, since the upper limit is not fixed and depends on the trade off between response time, fault-tolerance and resulted bus load configured for the AUTOSAR UdpNm coordination algorithm. This might depend on the physical layer used.
